scientific_integrity.reproducibility: verify.py checks finite covariance quadratures, edge coefficient, mean-response derivative, log-convexity and short-lag generator identity.
scientific_integrity.statement: Analytic proof with a strictly positive gamma-Laplace covariance spectrum and endpoint asymptotic; independent finite numerical quadratures corroborate the identities but are not infinite proofs.

scientific_limitations: Stationary infinite-history homogeneous Poisson global reheating and deterministic power-law homogeneous cooling only; excludes finite-particle collision fluctuations and non-Poisson or incomplete reheating.
Recovery of parameters is from exact covariance and mean functions, not a statistically stable finite-data estimator.
Specific source novelty has been compared with inspected literature and accessible earlier records, but independent publication-priority verification has not been performed.
title: Spectral-edge relaxation and response identities for Poisson-reheated power-law cooling
